summary: The Fairbanks court sent two cases to a grand jury on Wednesday: a North Pole sexual abuse of a minor case and a Fairbanks assault case with a child-present count. Five new Fairbanks criminal cases were opened, one of them closed the same afternoon when no charging document was filed behind a felony assault arrest. Troopers reported a pickup taken from a Fairbanks mobile home park. The 37 Fairbanks filings counted below are the weekly charges report's own count for its window of Nov. 18 to Nov. 24, and that report lists no cases at the Nenana, Healy or Delta Junction courts for the week; the court has also filed at least one Fairbanks case inside that window, 4FA-26-02345CR of Nov. 23, that the report does not list.

entries.title: Sexual abuse of a minor indictment: Donald Lawrence Geuea
body: Donald Lawrence Geuea is charged with two counts of sexual abuse of a minor in the second degree - sexual contact with a child under 13 - each a Class B felony. The court records both counts as domestic violence related. The offense location is North Pole and the offense date on the file is June 1, 2023.
A grand jury indictment was filed on Nov. 25 and the case was transferred to the Superior Court.
Case 4FA-26-02308CR. Superior Court arraignment Dec. 2 before Judge Brent E. Bennett; omnibus hearing Jan. 21, 2027; trial week Feb. 8, 2027.

entries.title: Assault indictment: Roger L Bouling
body: Roger L Bouling is charged with assault in the second degree - intentionally causing injury with a dangerous instrument - a Class B felony, punishable by up to 10 years; and with assault when a child is present, a Class A misdemeanor, which is a fourth-degree assault committed in a child's presence. The court records both counts as domestic violence related. Fairbanks, offense date Aug. 23, 2026.
A grand jury indictment was filed on Nov. 25, with a further information adding the misdemeanor count to it.
Case 4FA-26-02339CR. Bail hearing Nov. 30; Superior Court arraignment Dec. 16; trial week Jan. 4, 2027, before Judge Brent E. Bennett.

entries.title: Felony assault arrest closed with no charge filed: Isaiah Joseph Aparezuk
body: Isaiah Joseph Aparezuk, 19, was arrested on a charge of assault in the third degree - causing another person to fear injury with a weapon - which Fairbanks Police recorded as a felony. 700 block of Seventh Avenue, Fairbanks, Nov. 24 at 6:22 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.

The Fairbanks court opened a case in his name on Nov. 25 and closed it the same day, recording that no complaint or citation was filed. No charge was brought and no charge class appears on the court record.
Police case 26003569; court case 4FA-26-02346CR, closed.

entries.title: Felony assault arrest: Jeremiah Fagan Alexander
body: Jeremiah Fagan Alexander, 35, was arrested on a charge of assault in the third degree - causing another person to fear injury with a weapon - a Class C felony, punishable by up to five years. 500 block of Twelfth Avenue, Fairbanks, Nov. 24 at 1:41 a.m.; Fairbanks Police.
The Fairbanks court filed one count the same day. The court does not record the count as domestic violence related.
Police case 26003560; court case 4FA-26-02340CR, before Judge Earl A. Peterson. Preliminary hearings Dec. 3 and Dec. 14.

sources.label: Fairbanks Daily News-Miner public safety report, Nov. 25

entries.title: Theft and trespass arrest: Oliver Leon Delp
body: Oliver Leon Delp, 36, is charged with criminal trespass in the second degree - entering or remaining unlawfully on another's premises - and theft in the fourth degree - taking property worth less than $250. Both are Class B misdemeanors. 1500 block of South Cushman Street, Fairbanks, Nov. 24 at 3:54 p.m.; Fairbanks Police.
Case 4FA-26-02344CR, filed Nov. 25 before Judge Ben A. Seekins. Arraignment Dec. 1.

entries.title: Brown bear and trail camera charges: Michael S Crane
body: Michael S Crane is charged with two counts drawn from the state hunting regulations: brown bear seasons and bag limits for Unit 20B, and an unlawful method of taking game recorded on the file as a wireless trail camera. Both are Class A misdemeanors. Fairbanks, offense date June 20, 2026.
Case 4FA-26-02345CR, filed Nov. 23 before Judge Maria P. Bahr. A summons was issued to the Alaska State Troopers at Fairbanks on Nov. 25. No court date is set on the file.

entries.title: DUI charge: Felipe Gomez Soto
body: Felipe Gomez Soto is charged with driving under the influence of alcohol or a controlled substance, a Class A misdemeanor. Fairbanks, offense date Nov. 20.
Case 4FA-26-02320CR, before Judge Ben A. Seekins. Arraignment Nov. 27.

entries.title: Pickup reported stolen from a Fairbanks mobile home park
body: Troopers say they received a delayed report of a stolen vehicle at about 7:10 a.m. on Nov. 25. The complainant reported that a green 1997 Ford F250 was taken from Wildwood Mobile Home Park between 8 a.m. on Nov. 24 and 7:10 a.m. on Nov. 25.

Troopers describe the truck as having a plow mount with no plow, rust above the rear wheel wells, an aluminum toolbox, a rectangular hole in the driver's side of the front bumper, circular LED lights on the rear bumper and several bumper stickers. No arrest has been reported and the investigation is continuing.
Incident AK26115992.
